'''Antonio M. Echavarren Pablos''' (born 1955) is a Spanish [[chemist]] who has contributed
to the recent advances in gold<ref>{{Cite Q|Q46783600|author= Porcel, S. |author2=López-Carrillo, V.|author3=García-Yebra, C.|author4= Echavarren, A. M.}}</ref> and palladium<ref>{{Cite Q| Q80799990|author= Pascual, S.|author2= de Mendoza, P. |author3= Echavarren, A. M. }}</ref> chemistry.

He obtained his PhD at the [[Universidad Autonoma de Madrid]] in 1982. Since 1992 he is a full professor at Universidad Autonoma de Madrid, where he heads the Research Group on Organometallic Chemistry Directed Towards Organic Synthesis.<ref>[http://www.uam.es/departamentos/ciencias/qorg/investigacion/organomet/welcome.htm Research Group headed by Antonio M. Echavarren] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091002121654/http://www.uam.es/departamentos/ciencias/qorg/investigacion/organomet/welcome.htm |date=October 2, 2009 }}, accessed on 2009-09-27.</ref> Since 2004 he is working as Group Leader at the Institute of Chemical Research of [[Catalonia]] ([http://www.iciq.es/ ICIQ]).
